zh: 摆上酒来，宾主相向相坐；郁馥华学做官人家的派头，子弟侍立执役，任凭尤五怎么说，郁松年不敢陪席。等他执壶替客人斟满了，郁复华郑重其事地双手举杯，高与鼻齐，专敬尤五；自然有两句要紧话要交代。『五哥，』他说，『这几年多有不到的地方，一切都请包涵。江海一家，无分南北西东；以后要请五哥随处指点照应。』说着，仰脸干了酒，翻杯一照。尤五既为修好而来，自然也干了杯，『郁老大，』他也照一照杯，『过去的事，今天一笔勾销。江海一家这句话不假，不过有些地方，也要请老大你手下的弟兄，高抬贵手！』『言重、言重！』郁馥华惶恐地说了这一句，转脸问道∶『看福全在不在？』
en: The wine was brought out, and host and guest sat facing each other. Yu Fuhua had adopted the style of an official household, with the younger members standing by to wait on their elders. However much Brother You urged him, Songnian dared not join them at the table. Once he had filled the guest’s cup, Yu Fuhua solemnly raised his own in both hands to the level of his nose and offered a toast to Brother You alone. Naturally, there were a few important words to be said. “Brother Five, I have been remiss in many ways these past few years. I beg you to overlook it all. River and sea belong to one family; north, south, east, or west makes no difference. From now on, I shall rely on your guidance and help.” He tipped back his head, drained the wine, and turned the empty cup toward his guest. Since Brother You had come to make peace, he drank his own cup dry as well. “Chief Yu,” he said, showing that it was empty, “let us wipe out the past today. River and sea do belong to one family. Still, in certain matters, I must ask you to have your men show us a little consideration.” “You are too kind, too kind!” Yu said with an air of trepidation. Then he turned aside. “See whether Fuquan is here.”

zh: 尤五也知道这个人，是帮郁复华创业的得力助手；如今也是面团团的富家翁。当时将他唤了来，不待郁复华有所言语，便兜头作了个大揖，满脸暗笑地寒暄∶『尤五叔，你老人家还认得我吧？』『喔，』尤五有意眨一眨眼，作出惊喜的神气，『是福全哥，你发福了。』『不敢当，不敢当。尤五叔，你叫我小名好了。』『真的，他们是小辈；尤五哥你客气倒是见外了。』郁馥华接着转脸告诫福全∶『你关照下去，江海一家，松江漕帮的弟兄，要当自己人一样，处处尊敬、处处礼让。尤五叔有啥吩咐，就跟我的话一式一样。』他说一句，福全答应一句；神态不但严肃，而且诚恳。江湖上讲究的是『受人一尺，还人一丈』；尤五见此光景，少不得也有一番推诚相与、谦虚退让的话交代。
en: Brother You knew the man: he had been an able assistant to Yu Fuhua when the latter was building his fortune and was now a prosperous, round-faced gentleman himself. Summoned into the room, Fuquan did not wait for his employer to speak, but immediately made a deep bow. With a broad smile he offered his greeting. “Uncle You, you still remember me, I hope?” “Oh!” Brother You deliberately blinked and assumed an expression of delighted surprise. “Brother Fuquan! You have filled out.” “I would not presume to be called your brother, Uncle You. Just call me Fuquan.” “Indeed, they are all your juniors. Such politeness only puts a distance between us, Brother You.” Yu then turned to instruct Fuquan. “Pass the word: river and sea are one family. The men of the Songjiang Grain-Boat Guild are to be treated as our own, with respect and consideration in everything. Whatever Uncle You orders is exactly as if I had said it myself.” Fuquan acknowledged each instruction. His manner was not merely solemn, but sincere. In their world, a man repaid a foot of kindness with ten feet in return. Seeing this, Brother You could hardly fail to respond with assurances of trust, friendship, modesty, and mutual consideration.

zh: 多时宿怨，一旦解消，郁馥华相当高兴。从利害关系来说，沙船帮虽然兴旺一时，而漕帮到底根深蒂固，势力不同，所以两帮言归于好，在沙船帮更尤其来得重要。郁馥华是个极有算计的人，觉得这件事值得大大铺张一番；传出去是尤五自己愿意修好，岂不是足可以增加光彩与声势的一件好事？打定了主意，当即表示，就在这几天，要挑个黄道吉日，大摆筵宴，略申敬意。言语恳切，尤五不能也不宜推辞；当下未吃先谢，算是定了局。
en: Yu Fuhua was delighted to see a long-standing feud dissolved in a single meeting. In terms of their respective interests, although the Sea-Junk Guild was prospering for the moment, the Grain-Boat Guild had deep roots and a different order of influence. Reconciliation therefore mattered even more to the sea-junk men. Yu was an exceptionally calculating man, and he felt that the occasion deserved a splendid public celebration. If word spread that Brother You had come voluntarily to restore friendly relations, would that not add greatly to Yu’s prestige and standing? Having made up his mind, he immediately announced that he would choose an auspicious day within the next few days and give a grand banquet as a modest token of respect. He spoke so earnestly that Brother You could neither refuse nor properly wish to. He thanked his host for the meal before it had even been prepared, and the matter was settled.

zh: 这一下情分就更觉不同，郁馥华豪饮快谈，兴致极好。尤五却颇为焦急，他是有要紧事要谈，哪有心思叙旧？但又不便扫他的高兴；这样下去，等主人喝得酪酊大醉，岂不白来一趟？等了又等，也是忍了又忍，快将忍不住时，郁松年看出苗头，提醒他父亲说∶『爹！尤五叔有事要跟爹商量呢！』『喔，喔，是的。』郁馥华不能再装马虎了，随即转脸说道∶『尤五哥，你倒请再说一遍看。』
en: Their friendship now seemed closer still. Yu Fuhua drank freely and talked merrily, in the highest of spirits. Brother You, however, was growing anxious. He had urgent business to discuss; how could he give his mind to reminiscence? Yet he could hardly spoil his host’s pleasure. If this went on until Yu was hopelessly drunk, would the whole visit not have been wasted? He waited and waited, restraining himself again and again. Just as his patience was about to give out, Songnian noticed and reminded his father, “Father, Uncle You has something to discuss with you.” “Oh, yes, of course.” Yu could no longer pretend to have forgotten. He turned to his guest. “Please tell me again, Brother You.”

zh: 『是这样的，有一批米，要借重老大你的船；走海道，由海宁进鳖子门，入钱塘江，运到杭州。』尤五又说，『杭州城里的百姓，不但吃草根树皮，在吃人肉了；所以这件事务必要请老大你帮忙，越快越好。』『尤五哥，你的事，一句话。不过，沙船帮的情形，瞒不过你，鳖子门这条路从来没有去过，水性不熟，会得搁浅，岂不耽误大事？』他紧接着说，『当然，漕帮弟兄可以领路，不过沙船走到江里，路道不对。这样子，我马上找人来商量，总要想条万全之计。好不好明天给你回话？』
en: “It is this. There is a consignment of rice for which we need your boats. It must go by sea, enter Biezimen at Haining, and travel up the Qiantang River to Hangzhou. The people inside the city are no longer merely eating roots and bark. They are eating human flesh. We absolutely must have your help, Chief Yu, and the sooner the better.” “For anything of yours, Brother You, you have only to say the word. But you know our circumstances. The Sea-Junk Guild has never taken the Biezimen route. We do not know the waters and might run aground. That could ruin the whole undertaking.” He hurried on. “Of course, your grain-boat men could pilot us, but taking sea junks into the river is not the proper way to use them. Let me send for some people at once and discuss it. We must find a plan that is safe in every respect. May I give you an answer tomorrow?”

zh: 听得这一说，尤五颇为不悦；心里在想，这种兵荒马乱的时候，到哪里都是冒险；就算承平时候，风涛险恶，也没有什么保险不出事的把握。说要想一条万全之计，不就是有心推托？想是这样想，当然决没有发作的道理，不过话要点他一句，『郁老大，』他说，『亲兄弟，明算帐，人情归人情，生意归生意；请你仔细盘算一下，运费出公帐，何必放着河水不洗船？』『言重，言重！尤五哥，你误会了，我决不是在这上头打算盘。为的是┅┅。』郁馥华觉得怎么样说都不合适，而且也要问问路上的情形，便改口问道∶『尤五哥，那位胡道台，我久仰大名，好不好领我会一会他？』胡道台就是胡雪岩；这几年连捐带保，官运亨通，成了浙江省城里亦官亦商的一位特殊人物；尤五原就有意替他们拉拢见一面，现在郁馥华自己开口，当然毫无推辞，而且表示∶『说走就走，悉听尊便。』
en: Brother You was distinctly displeased. In such a time of war and disorder, he thought, where could one go without taking risks? Even in peace, with treacherous winds and waves, no one could guarantee freedom from mishap. Was this talk of finding a wholly safe plan not simply a deliberate excuse? He thought so, but there was naturally no question of losing his temper. Still, he had to give the man a hint. “Chief Yu, even brothers keep clear accounts. Friendship is friendship, and business is business. Work out the figures carefully. The freight will be paid from public funds. Why leave the river water unused when you could wash your boat in it?” “Please, please! You misunderstand me, Brother You. I am certainly not calculating my advantage in that respect. My concern is—” Whatever he said seemed wrong. He also needed to learn more about conditions along the route, so he changed tack. “I have long heard of that Circuit Intendant Hu. Might you introduce me to him?” Circuit Intendant Hu was Hu Xueyan. Over the past few years, purchased rank and recommendations for promotion had carried him smoothly upward, making him a peculiar figure in Zhejiang’s provincial capital: part official, part merchant. Brother You had intended to bring the two men together in any case. Now that Yu had asked, he agreed without hesitation. “We can go this moment, if you wish. I am entirely at your disposal.”

zh: 『今天太匆促了！一则喝了酒，二则，草草未免不恭。准定明天一早，我去拜访；不知道胡道台耽搁在哪里？』『他住在舍亲古应春家。明天一早我来接。』『原来是老古那里。我们也是熟人，他府上我去过；不必劳驾，我自己去就是了。』谈到这里，告一段落；而且酒也够了，尤五起身告辞。一回到古家，七姑奶奶迎上前来，虽未开口，那双眼睛却比开口还显得关切。
en: “Today would be too hurried. For one thing, I have been drinking; for another, a hastily arranged call might seem disrespectful. I shall certainly visit first thing tomorrow. Where is Circuit Intendant Hu staying?” “At the house of my relative, Gu Yingchun. I shall come and fetch you in the morning.” “So he is at Old Gu’s! We know each other too, and I have been to his house. Do not trouble yourself. I can go on my own.” That brought their discussion to a close, and they had drunk enough as well. Brother You rose to take his leave. When he returned to Gu’s house, the Seventh Lady came forward to meet him. Even before she spoke, her eyes expressed a concern stronger than words.

zh: 『怎么样？』尤五不答，只问胡雪岩的伤势如何？这倒是使得七姑奶奶可以高兴的，夸赞伤科医生有本事；胡雪岩的痛楚大减，伤口好得很快，预计三天以后，就可以下床走动了。『这也是人到了这里，心就安了。』七姑奶奶又说，『人逢喜事精神爽，郁老大如果肯帮忙；真比吃什么药都有用。』『帮忙是肯帮的，事情没有那么快。先跟小爷叔谈了再说。』
en: “Well?” Brother You did not answer, but asked after Hu’s injury. Here the Seventh Lady had good news. She praised the doctor’s skill in treating wounds: Hu was in far less pain, the wound was healing quickly, and in three days he should be able to get out of bed and walk. “Part of it is that his mind has been at rest since he arrived here,” she added. “Good news lifts a man’s spirits. If Chief Yu will help, it will do him more good than any medicine.” “He is willing to help, but these things cannot be settled so quickly. Let me speak to Little Uncle first.”

zh: 于是从头谈起。一旁静听的七姑奶奶，先是一直含着笑；听到郁馥华说要明天才有回话，一下子跳了起来。『这明明是推托嘛！』『七姐，』胡雪岩赶紧拦住她说∶『人家有人家为难的地方。你先不要着急；慢慢儿商量。』『我是替你着急，小爷叔！』
en: Brother You began his account. The Seventh Lady stood listening beside them, smiling throughout the first part. When he reached Yu Fuhua’s promise to give an answer the next day, she sprang up. “That is plainly an excuse!” Hu hurried to restrain her. “Seventh Sister, he has difficulties of his own. Do not be anxious yet. Let us talk it through.” “It is for you that I am anxious, Little Uncle!”

zh: 『我晓得，我晓得。』胡雪岩依旧从容不迫地，『换了我是郁老大，也不能不仔细；海面上没有啥，一进了鳖子门，走在钱塘江里，两岸都是长毛，他自然要担足心事。这件事只有这样办，一方面，我们要跟他说实话，哪里有危险，哪里没有危险，出了危险，怎么样应付？一方面得要请他放点交情；冒一冒险。俗语说∶』前半夜想想人家，后半夜想想自己。「我们现在先想自己，有什么好处到人家那里；人家肯看交情上头，一冒一冒险。『』对！『尤五不胜倾倒，』小爷叔这两句话入情入理；照这样去想，事情就可以办通了。『』好吧！『七姑奶奶无可奈何；转个念头，自己女流之辈，可以不必来管这桩大事，便即说∶』天塌下来有长人顶，与我不相干，你们去商量。『说完转身就走。
en: “I know, I know,” Hu replied, as composed as ever. “If I were Chief Yu, I too should have to consider the matter carefully. There is little to fear at sea, but once we pass through Biezimen and enter the Qiantang, the Longhairs are on both banks. Naturally, he has every reason to be worried. There is only one way to proceed. On the one hand, we must tell him the truth: where the danger lies, where it does not, and what we shall do if trouble comes. On the other, we must ask him to put friendship before caution and take a risk. As the saying goes, spend the first half of the night thinking about others and the second half thinking about yourself. For the moment, let us consider our own part: what can we do for him that will make him willing, out of friendship, to take that risk?” “Quite right!” Brother You was full of admiration. “Little Uncle, that is both reasonable and fair. If we approach it that way, we can get the thing done.” “Very well!” The Seventh Lady could do nothing with them. Then she reflected that, as a woman, she need not concern herself with such weighty affairs. “If the sky falls, there are taller people to hold it up. It is nothing to do with me. You can discuss it yourselves.” She turned to go.

zh: 『七姐！』胡雪岩急忙喊道∶『有件事非跟你商量不可。你请回来！』她自然又立脚站定。胡雪岩原是听她的话近乎赌气，其实并没有什么事要她商量，不过既已说出口，倒又不得不找件事跟她商量了。灵机一动，开口只道∶『七姐，上海我半年不曾来过了，最近有没有好的棺子？』『有啊！』七姑奶奶答道∶『新开一家泰和馆，一统山河的南北口味，我吃过几次，菜刮刮叫。』『地方呢，宽敞不宽敞？』『岂止宽敞？庆兴楼、复新园、鸿运楼，数得出的几家大馆子，哪一家都没有它讲究。』七姑奶奶问道∶『小爷叔，你是不是要请客？』
en: “Seventh Sister!” Hu called after her. “There is something I simply must consult you about. Please come back!” Naturally, she stopped. He had only called because her words sounded rather petulant; in fact, he had nothing to ask her. Now that he had spoken, however, he had to find something. An idea flashed into his mind. “Seventh Sister, I have not been in Shanghai for six months. Have any good restaurants opened lately?” “Yes!” she replied. “There is a new one called Taihe. It serves northern and southern dishes from all over the country. I have eaten there several times. The food is first-rate.” “And the place itself—is it spacious?” “Spacious? It is more than that! Qingxinglou, Fuxinyuan, Hongyunlou—none of the big restaurants you can name is so splendidly fitted out.” She looked at him. “Are you thinking of giving a banquet, Little Uncle?”

zh: 『我的心思瞒不过七姐。』胡雪岩笑着回答，是有意恭维她一句；然后转脸看着尤五说∶『五哥，你既然委屈了，索性看我们杭州一城百姓的面上，委屈到底，请你出面请个客拿郁老大手下的大小脚色都请到；我们漕帮弟兄，最好也都到场，给足了他面子，看他怎么说？』『好的。一句话。』『那就要托七姐，定泰和馆的席。名归五哥出，钱归我出┅┅。』『这用不着你交代。』七姑奶奶抢着说，『就不知道有多少人；要定多少桌席。』这当然要问尤五，他慢吞吞地答道∶『要么不请；请了就不管他多少人了。我只一张帖子，统请沙船帮全体弟兄；拿泰和馆包下来，开流水席，有一桌算一桌。』『这倒也痛快。就这么说了。』胡雪岩向七姑奶奶拱拱手∶『拜托、拜托！』
en: “Nothing escapes you, Seventh Sister.” Hu smiled; the compliment was deliberate. Then he turned to Brother You. “Brother Five, since you have already humbled yourself, do it to the end for the sake of all the people of Hangzhou. Give a banquet in your name and invite every man under Chief Yu, great or small. It would be best if all our grain-boat men were there too. Let us pay him every possible honor and see what he says.” “Certainly. You have only to ask.” “Then we must trouble Seventh Sister to book the tables at Taihe. The invitation will be in Brother Five’s name, and I shall pay—” “You need not tell me that,” she broke in. “What I need to know is how many guests there will be, and how many tables to order.” That, of course, was for Brother You to answer. “If we are going to invite them at all,” he said slowly, “we need not worry about how many. I shall send a single invitation to every brother in the Sea-Junk Guild. We shall take the whole restaurant and serve a continuous banquet: as many tables as are needed.” “That is a generous way to do it. Agreed.” Hu clasped his hands toward the Seventh Lady. “I leave it in your capable hands.”

zh: 七姑奶奶最喜欢排场热闹，一诺无辞；但粗中有细，想了想问道∶『哪一天请？』『不是要快嘛！』尤五答说，『要快就在明天。』七姑奶奶不作声，将排在门背后的皇历取了下来，翻了翻说∶『明天怕不成功，是好日子；总有人做亲，在它那里请客。后天是个平日，「宜祭祀、订盟、余事不宜。」不晓得可以不可以？』『可以！』胡雪岩接口便说∶『我们这就算「订盟」。』事不宜迟，七姑奶奶当时便取了一封银洋，亲自坐马车到泰和馆去定席。尤五便找古家的帐房赵先生来，写好一封大红全帖，送到乔家滨郁家，同时又派人去找他一个心爱的徒弟李得隆来办事。
en: The Seventh Lady loved a grand, lively occasion and agreed at once. Beneath her expansive manner, however, she had an eye for detail. After a moment’s thought she asked, “What day?” “Are we not in a hurry?” Brother You replied. “If we want to be quick, make it tomorrow.” Without a word, she took down the almanac hanging behind the door and turned its pages. “Tomorrow may not be possible. It is an auspicious day; someone is sure to be holding a wedding feast there. The day after is an ordinary day: ‘Suitable for sacrifices and the making of covenants; unsuitable for other undertakings.’ Would that do?” “Certainly,” Hu answered at once. “We can call this the making of a covenant.” There was no time to lose. The Seventh Lady took a wrapped packet of silver dollars and drove to Taihe herself to arrange the banquet. Brother You asked Mr Zhao, the Gu household’s accountant, to write out a full formal invitation on red paper and sent it to the Yu residence at Qiaojiabin. At the same time he summoned a favorite disciple, Li Delong, to help with the arrangements.

zh: 他们兄妹在忙，胡雪岩一个人躺在床上盘算；等尤五再回进来时，他已经盘算停当了。『五哥，我们现在一桩桩来谈。米怎么样？』『我已经关照下去，今天下午就可成局。』尤五答道∶『虽说多多益善，也要看郁老大有多少船？总而言之一句话，只要他有船，我就有米。』『那好。我们谈船。郁老大怕来怕去，最怕长毛。不过不要紧；长毛在岸上，我们在江里，他们没有炮船，就不必怕他。至多坐了小划子用洋枪来攻；我们自己能有一批人，备它几十杆好枪，说开火就开火，打他个落流水。』胡雪岩又说，『这批人，我也想好了；不知道老古跟杨坊熟不熟？』尤五懂他的意思，点点头说∶『很熟的。就不熟也不要紧。』『何以呢？』胡雪岩问。
en: While brother and sister were busy, Hu lay alone in bed and thought things through. By the time Brother You returned, his plans were ready. “Brother Five, let us take things one at a time. What about the rice?” “I have passed the word. We can have it settled this afternoon. The more the better, of course, but we must also see how many boats Chief Yu can provide. In a word: if he has the boats, I have the rice.” “Good. Now let us discuss the boats. Whatever else he fears, Chief Yu is most afraid of the Longhairs. But that need not stop us. They are on shore, and we shall be on the river. They have no gunboats, so there is no need to fear them. At worst, they can come out in small craft and attack with foreign rifles. If we have a force of our own, with a few dozen good guns, we can open fire as soon as necessary and rout them. I have thought of where to find the men too. Is Old Gu well acquainted with Yang Fang?” Brother You understood his intention and nodded. “Very well acquainted. And even if he were not, it would not matter.” “Why is that?” Hu asked.

zh: 『小爷叔，你的意思是不是想借洋将华尔的人？』『对啊！』胡雪岩问，『不是说洋将跟上海道的交涉，都是杨坊在居间接头的吗？』『一点不错。杨坊是「四明公所」的董事；宁波也是浙江，为家乡的事，他没有不肯出力的道理，就算不认识，一样也可以请他帮忙。』『我对此人的生平不大清楚，当然是有熟人从中说话，事情更容易成功。不过，我想是这样，行不行得通，还不晓得。先要问一问老古；他不知道什么时候回来？』『不必问他，』尤五手一指∶『现在有个人在这里。』这个人就是萧家骥。他是一早跟了古应春去办事的；由于胡雪岩关照，王有龄的两封血书要面递薛焕，所以古应春一直守在江苏巡抚设在上海的行署中，等候传见。为怕胡雪岩惦念，特地先派萧家骥回来送信。
en: “Little Uncle, do you mean to borrow some men from Ward, the foreign commander?” “Exactly. Is Yang Fang not the intermediary in all the foreign commander’s negotiations with the Shanghai circuit intendant?” “Quite right. Yang is a director of the Siming Guildhall. Ningbo is in Zhejiang too; he has every reason to help his home province. Even without a personal acquaintance, we could still ask him.” “I know little of the man’s background. Of course, a mutual friend would make the matter easier. But this is only my idea; I do not yet know whether it will work. We must ask Old Gu first. When will he be back?” “There is no need to ask him.” Brother You pointed. “We have someone here already.” He meant Xiao Jiaji, who had gone out with Gu early that morning. Hu had instructed them to deliver Wang Youling’s two letters written in blood to Xue Huan in person, so Gu was still at the Jiangsu governor’s temporary headquarters in Shanghai, waiting to be received. Fearing that Hu would be anxious, he had sent Xiao back ahead with a message.

zh: 『你看，』胡雪岩对尤五说，『这就是我刚才盘算，要借重洋将的道理。官场办事，没有门路。就会行不通；要见薛抚台一面都这么难，哪里还能巴望他派兵替我们护粮。就算肯派；也不是三天两天就走得动的。』他加重语气又说∶『我主意打定了，决定我们自己想办法。』于是尤五将他的打算告诉了萧家骥；萧家骥静静地听完，并未作声。『怎么样？家骥！』胡雪岩催问着∶已看出他另有主意。『这件事有个办法，看起来费事，其实倒容易。』他说，『不如请英国或者法国的海军提督，派兵船护送。』『这——』尤五首先就表示怀疑，『这行得通吗？』『行得通的。』萧家骥说∶『外国人另有一套规矩，开仗是一回事，救老百姓又是一回事。如果说∶这批米是军粮，他们就不便护送；为了救老百姓，当然可以。』听这一说，胡雪岩大为高兴；但是，『这要怎么样说法；跟哪个去接头？』他问。『我就可以去！』萧家骥自告奋勇；但立刻又加了一句∶『不过先要问问我师父。』
en: “You see,” Hu said to Brother You, “this is just why I have been thinking of using the foreign commander’s men. In official business, unless you have the right connections, you get nowhere. If even obtaining an audience with Governor Xue is so difficult, how can we hope for troops to escort our grain? Even if he agreed, they could not be on their way in two or three days.” He emphasized his next words. “My mind is made up. We shall find our own solution.” Brother You explained their plan to Xiao, who listened quietly without speaking. “Well, Jiaji?” Hu urged him, already sensing that he had another idea. “There is a way. It looks troublesome, but in fact it is easier. Why not ask the British or French admiral to send warships as an escort?” “But—would that be possible?” Brother You was the first to express doubt. “It would,” Xiao said. “Foreigners have another set of rules. Fighting a war is one thing; saving civilians is another. If this rice were military provisions, they could not properly escort it. If it is to save the common people, of course they can.” Hu was delighted to hear this. Still, there was a question. “How should we put the request, and whom should we approach?” “I can go myself,” Xiao volunteered, but immediately added, “Only I must consult my teacher first.”

zh: 『你的师父当然赞成，』尤五接口说道，『不过，我始终不大相信，只怕没有这么好的事。』『那也不妨双管齐下。』胡雪岩问萧家骥∶『你看，我们自己出钱，请华尔派几十个人保护，这个办法可以不可以试一试？』『试是没有什么不可以试的。』萧家骥答说∶『不过，我看很难。为什么呢——。』为的是第一，华尔部下的『佣兵』，已经为上海道吴煦『惯』坏了，花了大钱，未必能得他们的出死力；第二，这批佣兵是『步军』，在水上能不能发挥威力，大成疑问。『说得有道理。』胡雪岩最不肯掩没人的长处，对萧家骥大为欣赏，『家骥，这件事倒要请你好好帮我一个忙。』『胡先生言重了，有什么事，尽管吩咐就是。』
en: “Your teacher will certainly approve,” Brother You put in. “But I am still doubtful. I fear there may be no such good fortune.” “Then we can try both approaches at once,” Hu said, asking Xiao, “What if we paid Ward ourselves to send a few dozen men to protect us? Could we try that?” “There is no harm in trying,” Xiao replied. “But I think it would be difficult, and for two reasons.” First, Wu Xu, the Shanghai circuit intendant, had spoiled Ward’s mercenaries. Even a great deal of money might not persuade them to risk their lives. Second, they were infantry; whether they could make their strength felt on the water was very doubtful. “That is sound reasoning.” Hu was always ready to acknowledge another man’s merits, and he greatly admired Xiao. “Jiaji, I must ask you to give me all the help you can with this.” “You are too kind, Mr Hu. Whatever needs doing, you have only to tell me.”

zh: 一个赏识，一个仰慕，于是尤五有了一个计较，暂且不言；要等古应春回来了再说。『薛抚台见着了。』古应春的神情不愉，『小爷叔，王雪公要想指望他肯出什么大力，恐怕是妄想。』『他怎么说？』胡雪岩很沉着地问。
en: One man appreciated the other’s ability; the other looked up to him. Seeing this, Brother You conceived a plan of his own. He kept it to himself for the moment, intending to wait until Gu returned. “I saw Governor Xue,” Gu reported, plainly unhappy. “Little Uncle, if Mr Xuexuan hopes for any substantial help from him, I fear he is dreaming.” “What did he say?” Hu asked steadily.

zh: 不问还好，问起来教人生气。薛焕叹了一大遍苦经；又怪王有龄在浙江自己不想办法练军队，军饷都接济了皖南和江西，如今局势一坏，连带上海亦吃紧。又提到他在江苏的时候，如何跋扈刚愎；言下大有落到今日的光景，是自取其咎之意。『也难怪他！』古应春又说∶『京里闹得天翻地覆，两个亲王都送了命，如今又是恭王当政；一朝天子一朝臣，曾国藩也快到两江来了，薛抚台署理两江总督跟实缺江苏巡抚的两颗印把子，看起来摇摇欲坠，心境当然不好。』『我知道。』胡雪岩说，『你没有来之前，我跟五哥还有家骥，都商量过了；本来就不想靠他。不过，他到底是江苏巡抚，王雪公的折子，一定只有请他拜发。不知道这件事，他办了没有？』『这他不敢不办。』古应春说，『连催李元度的公事，都已经交待下去。我还怕下面太慢，特意打了招呼；答应所有的公事，明天都一起办出。』『那就不管它了。我们商量我们的。』
en: The question was enough to make Gu angry all over again. Xue Huan had recited a long catalogue of his own troubles. He blamed Wang Youling for failing to raise and train troops in Zhejiang and for sending all his military funds to southern Anhui and Jiangxi; now that the situation had deteriorated, Shanghai too was under pressure. He also recalled how overbearing and obstinate Wang had been during his time in Jiangsu. The clear implication was that Wang had brought his present plight on himself. “And one can hardly blame Xue for being in a bad temper,” Gu added. “Beijing has been turned upside down. Two princes have lost their lives, and Prince Gong is now in power. A new sovereign brings a new set of ministers. Zeng Guofan will soon be coming to Liangjiang too. Both seals in Governor Xue’s hands—acting governor-general of Liangjiang and substantive governor of Jiangsu—look in danger of slipping away. Naturally he is unhappy.” “I know,” Hu replied. “Before you came back, Brother Five, Jiaji, and I had already discussed things. We never intended to rely on him. But he is still the governor of Jiangsu, and we have no choice but to ask him to forward Mr Xuexuan’s memorial to the throne. Has he done that?” “He would not dare refuse. He has even given orders for the dispatch urging Li Yuandu to hurry. I was afraid the clerks might be slow, so I spoke to them specially. They promised to send all the official papers out together tomorrow.” “Then let us leave that alone and discuss our own plans.”

zh: 于是尤五和萧家骥将刚才所谈经过，原原本本说了给古应春听。这在他是个很大的安慰；本来为了要见薛焕，将大好时光，白白糟蹋，不但生气，而且相当着急。照现在看起来，路子甚多，事情并不是无处措手，因此愁怀一去，精神大为振作。
en: Brother You and Xiao Jiaji gave Gu a full account of their earlier discussion. It was a great comfort to him. Wasting so much valuable time waiting to see Xue Huan had left him not only angry but seriously anxious. Now it appeared that several courses were open; they were by no means at a loss where to begin. His worries lifted, and his spirits revived.
